codebase-memory.__comment: Persistent codebase memory: caches file summaries + symbol graphs so the assistant retrieves compact context instead of re-reading whole files each turn. Enable once installed (`uvx codebase-memory-mcp` or the team's chosen build).

graphify.__comment: Builds a code dependency/symbol graph. The assistant queries the graph (a few hundred tokens) instead of loading many files to understand how components relate.

caveman.__comment: Aggressive context compaction / retrieval helper. Returns minimal relevant slices of files on demand. Kept disabled by default; enable per session when working in large modules.
